title: Check reading's relied-on earlier-job files exist in the snapshot
summary: Retry of job 20261030-060751-5389, which failed in planning round 3. Add a refusal in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, run from read_once via check_reading_acceptance, that refuses a reading relying on an earlier job's or path's unlanded files. Part 3 starts only from jobs, paths or file stems the reading's own text names; jobs the request merely cites as evidence stay unchecked. Audience: the planner, critic and verifier, who now find missing dependencies late.

defaults_applied.how: Criteria check readings being refused or accepted, not that code exists.
Criteria require cargo test, clippy and fmt to pass.
Fix sits in the reading-acceptance check, covering the class.
Behavior criteria run named cargo test commands.
The decision record and CHANGELOG are written for an outside reader.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Retry of job 20261030-060751-5389 (failed in planning, no candidate, no files changed). Its findings are addressed: (1) major, Part 3 over-refusing cited jobs: fixed by starting only from what the reading's own text names (job id, an unlanded added path, or its file stem); evidence-only citations stay unchecked as at reading.rs:510-512, and a test has a request citing a rejected job with unlanded files, the reading never mentions it, and the reading accepted. (2) minor, symbol-shape rule: CamelCase and UPPER_SNAKE words count only with a code marker (backtick span, `::` path or following `(`), so GitHub and env-var names are not candidates; guard tests for both. (3) nit, crate-relative paths like src/reading.rs: stated in docs/decisions.md as unchecked, with a test showing it. (4) minor, run_pin_tests.rs not a deliverable: now listed as a deliverable because the reader-level test through Athena::ask lives there.
Self-application: the reading for this request, which cites six jobs but relies on none, is a test case and must be accepted.

Code survey: entry point is read_once (crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs:372), which calls check_reading_acceptance (reading.rs:2678); the new check is added there beside check_boundary_and_repo_files (2600), reusing referenced_jobs (2335), unaccounted_files (2472) and names_path_token (2516). Path and symbol existence are measured directly against the snapshot file list and file contents, not via a stand-in. The change adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not affected. Reader-level tests go in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs through Athena::ask.

Symbol matching beyond definitions found in .rs files and any change to dependency planning are not done here. The prior job's recorded refusal-rate estimate is kept: expected 8% of newly refused readings.

acceptance_criteria.text: Unit test in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs: a reading that names an earlier job id (or one of its unlanded paths or file stems) as something it builds on is refused with a message naming the job and the missing files. The same reading is accepted when the item is a create deliverable, is in out_of_scope, or exists in the snapshot. Run: cargo test -p athena-core reading. The test fails without the change.
A test uses at least two distinct missing dependencies (an unlanded path and a symbol or role) so the class is covered, not one job's case. Run: cargo test -p athena-core reading.

A test where the request cites several rejected jobs with unlanded files, and the reading never names them, is accepted, using this request's own wording and reading as one case. Run: cargo test -p athena-core reading.
A reader-level test in crates/athena-core/src/run_pin_tests.rs through Athena::ask fails if the check is not wired into read_once. Run: cargo test -p athena-core run_pin.

Guard tests show that GitHub and an environment-variable name in a survey are not refused, and that a crate-relative path such as src/reading.rs is documented as unchecked with a test showing it. Run: cargo test -p athena-core reading.

The change refuses more readings and the higher refusal rate is intended: expected 8% of newly refused readings. A replay or test over stored past readings shows none that were previously accepted and rely on nothing from a cited job is newly refused. Run: cargo test -p athena-core.

CHANGELOG.md and docs/decisions.md name the root cause (readings take a named earlier job's deliverable as existing without checking the snapshot), say the fix sits in the reading-acceptance check in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, and record the narrowings (evidence-only citations unchecked, crate-relative paths unchecked, symbol-marker rule).
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy and cargo test all pass. Run those from the repository root.

out_of_scope: Retrying jobs 20261026-042558-5p65, 20261026-064950-38jx, 20261026-065228-02zf; their candidate files (crates/athena-core/src/code_health.rs, steward.rs, status.rs, gh.rs, display.rs, run.rs, introspect.rs, jev.rs, records.rs, briefs.rs) are dropped, not kept
Symbol-shape matching beyond definitions found in .rs files, and any change to dependency planning
departures: Higher cost and lower pass odds than the reference: this adds a refusal rule, the previous attempt failed three planning rounds, and the change touches a gate.
urgent_reason: Cuts repeated failed and rejected attempts: the same missing-dependency class has hit 6 jobs, and the previous attempt wasted planning rounds.
hard_reason: Adds a rule that refuses readings in the reading-acceptance gate, so a false refusal would block work.
